alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced disulfides were alkylated by adding 13 ul of 160 mM chloroacetamide (33 mM final) and incubating for 45min at 25°C in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After digestion with 0.5 ug of Trypsin/LysC mix (Promega #V5073) for 2h at 25°C, sample supernatants were transferred in new tubes.
